milestones.claim: One keyed scheduler exists in core and both callers use it.
milestones.doneMeans: full-suite-runner imports the scheduler from core, npm test still passes all 47 members, and scheduler state is per-run rather than module-level.

milestones.claim: Every configured validate command has a resource claim, and an undeclared command is scheduled exclusively.
milestones.doneMeans: A command with no declared claim runs alone and is reported as exclusive; declared disjoint commands are allowed to overlap.

milestones.claim: executeValidationPlan schedules instead of looping, with unchanged evidence shape.
milestones.doneMeans: commands[] keeps plan order and per-entry fields, details[] stays ordered, every command runs even when one fails, and identity/progress/deadline behaviour is unchanged.

milestones.claim: The speedup is measured rather than asserted.
milestones.doneMeans: A regression runs the plan both ways in one run, asserts identical per-command outcomes, and prints serial, parallel and speedup numbers.
